description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Zero-runtime-dependency leaf shims we've triaged as leave-alone or vendored in-tree. A package with no dependencies has no transitive tree to rot, so abandonment is not actionable for it (fork trigger is abandoned AND an outdated dep). Suppress the abandonment flag to keep the Dependency Dashboards signal-only; forking any of these remains a deliberate, separately-tracked decision.
